propositions: A single environment variable (REBAR_LLM_MODEL) cannot express the intended four-pass model routing: Pass-1 finder on opus-family, Pass-2/Pass-4 verifier on sonnet-family

Code-review gate's five LLM-calling steps (base, round_a, round_b, verify, coach) declare per-step model classes via YAML, but the runtime plumbing does not honor these declarations and falls back to cfg.model
The verifier downgrade to sonnet-family is silently suppressed on non-default providers due to equality test (verifier_default if model == default_model else ...) that inverts on any Bedrock model ID
Batch steps (round_a, round_b) must use model_ladder with a single rung (not a multi-level ladder) to preserve deterministic per-criterion model resolution

Per-step model declarations (model: standard/frontier) are validated and parsed but unreached by the resolver during gate execution, creating a latent defect across both the new declarations and pre-existing ones from story 172e
